steps.title: Priya: coworking guest programme · part 1
steps.detail: Priya wants to welcome an independent hotel owner to the co-work community. One OTA page promises free placement, but its terms charge commission. What should her introduction explain?

choices.label: Placement terms, commission and the need for actual bookings
That placement guarantees a full hotel

steps.title: Priya: coworking guest programme · part 2
steps.detail: Priya has two versions of an OTA introduction. The attractive one uses an old room photo; the checked one shows the current room. Which should she share?

choices.label: Use the current room and label its actual amenities
Use the old photo because it looks luxurious
Promise amenities that might arrive later

steps.title: Priya: coworking guest programme · part 3
steps.detail: Priya introduces a client preparing an OTA placement page. The booking partner requires truthful copy and commission disclosure. What belongs in the agreed work?

choices.label: Verified room copy and disclosed channel terms
A promise of placement with no channel approval

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented coworking guest programme. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Priya.
